fuel_consumption.source_quote: As of December 31, 2018 we had hedged approximately 4% of our projected 2019 fuel requirements.

instrument_type_details.notes: 756 thousand barrels at Dec 31 2018 (756k x 42 = 31.752M gallons). Contracts settle by June 30 2019. Asset fair value ~$0 (shown as zero on balance sheet). Actual 2018 consumption hedged was 4%. Company had no hedges in 2017 but resumed hedging in 2018.
